newsitem.title: USA: IVI Publishing expands licensing pact.
newsitem.headline: IVI Publishing expands licensing pact.

text.p: IVI Publishing Inc said Tuesday it expanded its 1993 licensing agreement with United States Pharmacopeia (USP) to offer the not-for-profit organization's drug and pharmacological data on the Internet.

The drug databases will be produced in conjunction with the Mayo Clinic and available on the clinic's site on the World Wide Web, IVI Publishing said. The information from USP was used earlier in commercial CD-ROMS produced jointly by IVI and the Mayo Clinic, the company said.
IVI Publishing produces interactive multimedia health and medical information products.
Its shares were unchanged Tuesday afternoon at 3-1/8.
